description: This file defines the OutputHLSL class responsible for translating shader intermediate representation into HLSL code, including methods for traversing AST nodes, managing shader parameters, and generating shader code components.

classes.name: OutputHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for converting shader AST to HLSL code, managing shader parameters, and code generation.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Generates HLSL code from the shader AST root node.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBlockRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns mapping of shader storage block names to register indices.

methods.name: getUniformBlockRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns mapping of uniform block names to register indices.

methods.name: getUniformRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns mapping of uniform variable names to register indices.

methods.name: getReadonlyImage2DRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns register index for readonly 2D images.

methods.name: getUsedImage2DFunctionNames
methods.description: Returns set of used image function names.
